summary: Outlands Activation Slice — Lore layer pilot for Pivot Seven
context: Order 045 established trace parity across the Alfa Zero overlay. Pivot Seven now requires a proof-of-life overlay layer so operators can activate Lore beats without risking the core runtime.

directives.details: Thread overlay_id and layer_kind metadata through overlay_flow, overlay_bridge, and downstream payload traces. Maintain existing trace_id guarantees and document any new guardrails.
Expose an opt-in Lore overlay toggle inside alfa_zero_ui. Default to off; require explicit operator acknowledgement before emitting overlay annotations.
Emit a lore-layer dispatch that records matching trace_id + overlay_id fields across narration, telemetry, payload exports, and ledger entries. Archive evidence alongside the new Outlands index stub.
Add a lore overlay regression case to the contract/pytest suites demonstrating metadata preservation and guardrail compliance.
Update comfort_happy_path, automation_quick_start, outlands_index, and inlands_and_outlands.md with operator instructions and consent flow notes for activating the Lore layer.
File ledger updates and a completion report summarizing evidence, guardrails, and follow-on candidates (e.g., music/ritual overlays).

success_criteria: Overlay dispatch payloads, telemetry, and narration emit matching trace_id and overlay_id fields without breaking existing contracts.
Alfa Zero UI exposes an operator-controlled Lore overlay toggle with documented consent flow.
Lore overlay evidence (logs, payloads, ledger) captured and linked through outlands_index.md.
Regression coverage (contract and/or pytest) protects the overlay metadata pipeline.
Comfort and Outlands guides describe the activation protocol and cooldown expectations.
Completion report filed with next-slice recommendations for additional Outland layers.
